title: Design and Implement Models and Embeddings With SQL
summary: Integrate AI models with Azure SQL Database using external models, the vector data type, and built-in AI functions. Design embedding strategies, generate embeddings from text, and implement maintenance patterns.

title: Design and Implement Intelligent Search With SQL
summary: Implement intelligent search capabilities in SQL Server and Azure SQL by combining traditional full-text search with semantic vector search. Learn to choose search approaches, prepare SQL for vector search, and implement vector, hybrid, and ranking-based search patterns.

title: Design and Implement RAG With SQL
summary: Learn how to implement Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns using Azure SQL Database. Identify RAG use cases, prepare database context for Large Language Model (LLM) processing, construct augmented prompts, and process model responses.

title: Design and Implement Database Objects with SQL
summary: Learn how to design and implement database objects in SQL Server, Azure SQL, and SQL databases in Microsoft Fabric, including tables, indexes, constraints, and specialized table types.

title: Implement Programmability Objects with SQL
summary: Learn how to implement views, stored procedures, functions, and triggers in SQL Server to encapsulate logic, improve code reusability, and enforce business rules.

title: Write Advanced T-SQL Code
summary: Learn how to write advanced T-SQL code including CTEs, window functions, JSON functions, regular expressions, fuzzy string matching, graph queries, correlated queries, and error handling.

title: Implement SQL Solutions by Using AI-assisted Tools
summary: Learn how to use GitHub Copilot and Fabric Copilot for AI-assisted database development on Microsoft SQL platforms, including SQL Server, Azure SQL, and Microsoft Fabric.

title: Implement Data Security and Compliance With SQL
summary: Learn how to implement data security and compliance features in SQL Server, Azure SQL, and SQL databases in Microsoft Fabric, including encryption, masking, Row-Level Security, and auditing.

title: Optimize Database Performance
summary: Optimize Azure SQL Database performance by choosing the right service tier and managing concurrency with isolation levels. Analyze queries with execution plans and DMVs. Use Query Store for plan management and resolve blocking and deadlocks.

title: Implement CI/CD by Using SQL Database Projects
summary: Implement CI/CD for SQL Database Projects with source control, branching, schema drift detection, automated pipelines, and testing strategies using GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps.

title: Integrate SQL Solutions With Azure Services
summary: Learn how to use Data API Builder to create REST and GraphQL APIs for SQL databases, deploy to Azure, configure monitoring, and implement event-driven patterns for change handling.
